Why Academy

Built for proof, not seats.

  • 01 Plain English Lessons assume no technical background: real examples, step-by-step actions and key words explained.
  • 02 Missions, not videos Every course ends in a practice lab on fictional data with a deliverable you submit as evidence.
  • 03 Human review A qualified person assesses your work against a published rubric. AI may coach; it never certifies.
  • 04 Evidence you own Artefacts, versions and review notes stay private until you choose to share them.
  • 05 Five layers of proof Knowledge check, practical mission, project assessment, human review and independent verification.
  • 06 One-time purchase No subscription. Courses from $3 and bundles from $3 to $50, with lifetime access.

Credentials

Learning, assessment and verification stay separate.

  1. 01

    Completion record

    You finished the learning activity.

  2. 02

    Assessed submission

    A reviewer scored your work against the published rubric.

  3. 03

    Verified capability

    A different qualified person verified the evidence after a conflict check.

  4. 04

    Workplace experience

    Real delivery in a real workplace — never created by a course.
